caption:
Scammers love pretending to be the FTC. 🚨

The FTC says it got more than 1 million imposter-scam reports last year, with reported losses of $3.5 billion.

Real agencies don't demand gift cards or crypto over the phone.

Have you ever gotten a call or text like this?
first_comment: Be honest: did you spot it right away, or did it almost work? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Share this with someone who answers every unknown number. Follow @creditscoretruths for more.

card.headline: Imposter scams: $3.5 billion in reported losses.
